COMBINATION JUMP: make a substantive, coordinated change in EACH selected direction. 架构与交互: Coordinate backbone-appropriate blocks (GRU recurrence, NextItNet causal convolution, BERT4Rec masked bidirectional attention, or HSTU gated attention), feed-forward structure, residual paths and jointly trained interaction/scoring formulas such as bilinear compatibility.
联合调参: Jointly tune multiple numeric/categorical hyperparameters of the existing program: embedding/hidden dimensions, backbone depth, attention heads where applicable, convolution kernel size where applicable, feed-forward width, max history length, learning rate, dropout, weight decay, batch size, optimizer choice and scheduler settings. A candidate may change any compatible subset together; explain their coupling.
嵌入表征: Item embedding dimensions, parameterization, tying and embedding normalization.
序列与兴趣: Coordinate observed-history truncation, position representation and readout of encoder states, including recency or attention pooling.
For a jump, preservation rules apply to UNSELECTED directions. Shared changes must have one owner; do not claim the same edit for multiple directions. Keep observed-history data, registered model family, seed 42, epoch cap 200 and batches per epoch 200 fixed.
Maintain shape, checkpoint and predictor consistency for changes in the selected directions; preserve the registered direction boundaries.
spec.hypothesis: Memory available in state; agent should write a short arm-specific hypothesis; Agent hypothesis: Across all four datasets, factor item embeddings into a shared 64-dimensional table and separate learned input/output projections to 128 dimensions. Use two residual GRU blocks. Replace final-state-only readout with a learned gate combining the final real state and attention-pooled observed-prefix states, adding a learned nonnegative recency penalty to attention logits. Training pooling must be causal at every supervised position. Set maxlen=64, dropout=0.2, Adam LR=0.0005 and weight_decay=0.00001. Compact embeddings regularize the deeper recurrence while pooling preserves useful earlier interests. Preserve sampling and BPR.
